description: This file is a shell script that performs automated testing of the 'post-checkout' hook in a Git environment. It contains setup procedures, test cases for verifying the hook's behavior in various scenarios such as branch checkout, rebase, and clone operations, and utilises external test libraries and Git commands.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: A function that runs multiple rebase-related tests to verify the 'post-checkout' hook's correct operation during rebasing with different arguments and scenarios.
